messages:
sam: Quick question — for infra-only changes (metrics, logging, no API/schema changes) landed during the change window, do we always do a patch semver bump (x.y.(z+1)) or can we keep the patch the same and use an internal suffix like +infra.1?

tyler: I thought patch bump is the canonical move. Our deploy automation and dependents use semver ranges so keeping the same patch gets messy.

naomi: If it's truly backward-compatible impl-only then patch bump is semver-correct. Suffixes are okay for internal build IDs, but some package managers and tooling treat +metadata differently.

alex: +1. Rule of thumb: any new artifact that will be pulled by runtime should increment PATCH. Use metadata/suffix in CI for internal clarity but don’t rely on it for clients.

sam: Got it. Another quick one — rollbacks: for patch-only regressions do we allow fast rollback (single-click) or require a release-captain + QA signoff?

release-captain: Manual signoff required for production code rollbacks. Auto-backout allowed for config flags and infra toggles, but anything with code changes needs 2 approvals to rollback.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Starting deployment for tag v1.7.12 (patch) to prod-us-west — commit d4f5a6 — CI: https://ci.internal/build/1234

tyler: If we patch-bump every infra tweak, release notes get noisy. Can the release-notes generator group infra patches under a single collapsed section?

naomi: :thumbsup: We can add an "infra" PR label and have the notes script collapse those into one entry per release.

alex: Note on tagging: we do `git tag v1.7.12 && git push --tags`. For dedicated/private images we also stamp docker tags like v1.7.12-dedicated. Do we standardize those suffixes?

sam: Proposal: canonical semver tag remains plain `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`. Environment-specific markers belong in the image tag or CI metadata, not the canonical git tag. Agree?

tyler: Agree. Also propose a small checklist item on PRs: specify whether bump is patch/minor and add the release label. Saves post-merge tagging work.

release-captain: I'll update the release playbook: patch bumps allowed during change windows; minor bumps restricted to planned maintenance slots and need advance notice.

sam: Sweet. I'll file a short RFC to formalize and update the release-notes script to collapse infra labels.

naomi: RFC filed: https://rds.internal/rfcs/432 — putting the PR label + script changes on my plate.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployment finished for tag v1.7.12 — all prod checks green :tada:
